system.text:
This character is a son in the royal line. If he is the eldest, he is the direct heir to the throne. If he is a younger son, he bears no immediate obligation and is free to pursue his own aims. However, the character is a Prince and the obligations of said rank should play heavily on his life. He may, at some point, be called upon to take the throne!

Type: Char (character trait). Cost: 5 pts.

Restrictions: Humans only, special trait

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 316
